title: sound dropouts with Pixel 4a & soundcore BT devices
symptom: When using Soundcore BT devices (speaker or earbuds) with a Pixel 4a, the user experiences several seconds of garbled/muted sound occasionally, coinciding with glucose requests from Dex6, but not every time. The issue occurs once an hour or 2-3 times in a row and goes away after about 30 seconds. The problem does not occur with other brand audio devices, on the Moto G Power, or on the Pixel in safe mode or when collection is disabled.
fix: Turning off the watch in xDrip (Mi Band for the user) appears to resolve the garbled sound problem.
evidence_quote: So haven't confirmed it yet, but some experimenting it seems if I turn off the watch in xdrip (miband for me) the garbled sound problem goes away.
